payload.text: **A suite run in the shared checkout tests every peer's uncommitted work too.** On 24 Oct cc's slot 267 suite ran in ~/Devel/prj/Molt while dc's half-built issue 0047 work (liberators, test_helper, a new bats file) sat uncommitted beside it, so the verdict covered a tree no commit holds. While a suite runs, peers keep work in progress out of the shared tree, and vc validates the committed head in a clean worktree before pushing.
